title: The Rescue of the Tribe of Benjamin
description: After the Israelites had sworn at Mizpah not to give their daughters to the Benjamites, the tribe faced extinction. The assembly sent twelve thousand warriors against Jabesh in Gilead and brought four hundred virgins as wives. When this was not enough, they advised the remaining Benjamites to abduct dancing women during the annual festival at Shiloh so that the tribe could survive [ref:Judg 21:1-25|Judges 21:1-25].
